hero.lede: We provide trusted and dependable elderly care support to help seniors and their families manage everyday needs with comfort, safety, and confidence.

servicesSection.lede: No two families are the same — every plan is shaped around your parents' needs, routine, and personality.

0.title: Medical & Hospital Support
0.description: Assistance with doctor visits, hospital coordination, appointments, and medical requirements.

1.title: Emergency Support
1.description: Quick assistance and coordination during medical or other emergencies.

2.title: Well-Being Checking
2.description: Twice-a-week well-being checks, with updates sent to family members through WhatsApp.

3.title: 24/7 On-Call Support
3.description: Round-the-clock support whenever assistance is needed — day or night.

4.title: Logistics Support
4.description: Help with transportation, delivery, coordination, and other essential arrangements.

5.title: Paperwork & Billing Support
5.description: Assistance with documentation, medical paperwork, bills, and related administrative tasks.

6.title: Travelling Support
6.description: Support and coordination for local or outstation travel, appointments, and essential journeys.
